description: Catalog of deterministic accounting rules implemented in app/intelligence/rules.py. Severity CRITICAL blocks approval; WARNING requires reviewer attention. Parameters are configuration, not code.

rules.description: Detected document type must be processable by the selected purpose.
The same file (SHA-256) was processed before; CRITICAL if that job completed.
Mandatory fields must be present in the source.
Fields with LOW confidence or AMBIGUOUS status require human confirmation.
Amounts must parse as numbers and be greater than zero.
Dates must be real calendar dates, not in the future and not before the earliest valid year.
When the amount is also written in words, both must agree.
Reference number must be consistent with the payment mode (UTR for NEFT/RTGS, 12 digits for IMPS/UPI, 6 digits for cheque).
Cheque payments need a cheque number and cheque date.
GSTIN must match the 15-character format.
Either CGST = SGST with IGST zero (intra-state) or IGST only (inter-state).
Effective GST rate must be a valid slab for the invoice date.
IGST vs CGST/SGST must agree with supplier and recipient GSTIN state codes when both are present.
Sum of line items must equal the taxable value.
Taxable value + taxes + cess must equal the invoice total within rounding tolerance.
TDS must not exceed taxable value and should match a recognised section rate; section applicability is POLICY_REQUIRED.
Each row needs a date, particulars and amount; payment rows need a voucher number.
Voucher numbers should not repeat; gaps are reported.
Rows with the same date, amount and similar particulars are possible duplicates.
Row dates should fall inside the register period and be chronological.
Sum of payment rows must equal the written payment total; same for receipts.
Opening balance + receipts - payments = closing balance (only when opening and closing balances are readable).
Every mapped field needs an active Mapping_Master entry.
